hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

You will never be forgotten. 🕊️  Nutella Biscoff Cookie Pie 🍪🤎  Ingredients Cookie Dough * 200 g unsalted butter, melted * 160 g brown sugar * 70 g granulated sugar * 1 large egg * 1 egg yolk * 2 tsp vanilla extract * 290 g all-purpose flour * ½ tsp baking soda * ½ tsp baking powder * ½ tsp salt * 130 g semi-sweet or dark chocolate chips Filling * 250–300 g Nutella * 10–12 whole Biscoff cookies  Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 175°C / 350°F and grease a 26 cm (10-inch) round baking pan. 2. Mix the melted butter with the brown sugar and granulated sugar until combined. 3. Add the egg, egg yolk and vanilla extract. Mix until smooth. 4. Add the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Mix just until a cookie dough forms. 5. Fold in the chocolate chips. 6. Press about ⅔ of the cookie dough into the bottom of the pan and slightly up the sides. 7. Spread 250–300 g of Nutella evenly over the cookie dough, leaving about 1–2 cm around the edge. 8. Arrange 10–12 whole Biscoff cookies directly on top of the Nutella. 9. Flatten the remaining cookie dough between two sheets of parchment paper. Carefully place it over the Biscoff cookies and gently seal the edges. 10. Bake for 25–30 minutes, until the edges are golden brown but the center is still soft. 11. Let the cookie pie cool for at least 30 minutes before cutting.  #nutella #biscoff #chocolatechipcookie #Recipe #baking

Crispy Honey Garlic Chicken Fried Rice🍗🍯🍚 One of the best sheet pan recipes, so simple and delicious - Minimal effort, a game changing way to meal prep for the week! Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 550 Calories | 42g Protein | 52g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Honey Garlic Chicken - 1300g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed and fat trimmed - 2.5 Tsp Black Pepper - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - 50g Honey - 30g Light Soy Sauce  - 25g Dark Soy Sauce Creamy Sriracha Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt  - 120g Light Mayo - 50g Sriracha - 25g Honey - 1.5 Tsp Smoked Paprika Toasted Sesame Fried Rice - 450-500g Frozen Mixed Vegetables (i had carrots, sweetcorn, green beans, peas) - 100g Green Onion, white part - 40g Sesame Seeds - 350-400g Uncooked White Rice (700-800g Cooked) - 40g Light Soy Sauce (adjust based on color) - 50g Green Onion, green part - 20g Light Butter, gives silky smooth texture to rice 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake at 400°F for about 45 minutes, or until the corn is hot and tender. 7. Remove the foil and stir the creamy corn together. 8. Top with another ¼ cup Parmesan cheese, a sprinkle of paprika, and dried parsley. 9. Return to the oven uncovered for 5 more minutes. 10. High Protein Cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rolls🍗🧀🌯 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Roll - 10 Total) 438 Calories 25gC | 13gF | 65gP Want more recipes like this? check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients:  1.7KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Olive Oil 1 Large Diced Brown Onion 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 450g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 35g Grated Parmesan Cheese 100ml Low Fat Milk 2 Tsp Italian Herb Seasoning, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper, 1/2 Tsp Salt 60g Light Cream Cheese 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Mozzarella (per roll - 10 total) Egg Wash or Light Cooking Oil Spray Topping: Grated Parmesan Cheese & Parsley Flakes Instructions: 1. Slice chicken into fillets. Season with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder & salt, drizzle with olive oil and mix. 2. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for approximately 4 mins per side or until cooked through. Set aside and dice. 3. Cook onion in the chicken juices until softened. Add garlic and diced chicken, mix well, then turn off the heat. 4. Blend cottage cheese, parmesan, milk, Italian herbs, salt & cream cheese until smooth. 5. With the heat completely off, add the sauce, mozzarella & parsley to the pan and mix well. 6. Add 1/10th of the filling to each warm tortilla, add mozzarella, then roll tightly. 7. Place on a lined baking tray. Brush with egg wash or spray with oil, then top with parmesan & parsley flakes. 8. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 8 – 12 mins or until golden brown & crispy. #chicken #alfredo #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. The key to this recipe though, is the careful building of layers of flavour. Making the most of everything left behind in the pot at each stage to develop a sauce with real depth and richness. A gentle braise will give you beautifully tender chicken, but it’s the final reduction that transforms the braising liquid into a rich, glossy sauce. We get into all of that technique in the full article on Substack, from properly searing each component and building the sauce to controlling the temperature throughout the braise and getting that final reduction just right. Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. ENJOY! . . . . #grilledchicken #ricebowl #mealprep #healthyrecipes #chickenrecipes

🌿 5-Minute Dump & Bake Chicken Pesto A ridiculously easy one-pan dinner that tastes fancy but takes almost no effort. If you’ve got 5 minutes, a jar of pesto, and some chicken, dinner is basically done. This dump-and-bake pesto chicken turns juicy, cheesy, and flavorful with almost zero prep — just season, spread, and bake. 🍗 Ingredients 	•	4 chicken breasts 	•	Salt & pepper 	•	Garlic powder 	•	Oregano 	•	1 jar pesto 	•	6–8 slices mozzarella cheese Optional toppings (highly recommended): 	•	Fresh tomato slices 	•	Fresh basil 	•	Balsamic glaze 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Prep (takes about 5 minutes) Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or sheet pan. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. 2️⃣ Dump the pesto Spread a spoonful of pesto over each chicken breast, then dump the rest of the jar around the chicken so everything bakes in that garlicky goodness. 3️⃣ Bake Bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken. Chicken is ready when it reaches 165°F internal temperature. 4️⃣ Add the cheese Top each chicken breast with sliced mozzarella. 5️⃣ Melt & finish Return to the oven and bake or broil for 10–15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. ✨ Optional Finishing Touch Top with fresh tomato slices, basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a caprese-style upgrade.

Takeout-Style Chicken Onion Stir-Fry Ingredients: Chicken breast, thinly sliced 1 onion, sliced into strips Spring onion, cut into sections Ginger slices Minced garlic Oil for cooking A pinch of salt ½ cup water Marinade: 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp dark soy sauce ½ tbsp oyster sauce 1 tbsp cooking wine 1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp sugar 1 tsp chicken powder Black pepper 1 tbsp corn starch ½ tbsp sesame oil Steps: 1 Slice the chicken breast thinly. 2 Add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, cooking wine, baking soda, sugar, chicken powder, black pepper, corn starch, and sesame oil. Mix well and marinate for 15 minutes. 3 Slice the onion into strips. Cut the spring onion into sections, keeping the white and green parts separate. 4 Heat a little oil in a pan. Add the onion with a pinch of salt and stir-fry for 1 minute. Remove and set aside. 5 Add a little more oil if needed. Add ginger slices, minced garlic, chicken, and the white part of the spring onion. 6 Spread the chicken out and let it sear, then flip and stir-fry until cooked. 7 Add about ½ cup water. The corn starch from the chicken will loosen into the sauce and make it thick and glossy, so you don’t need extra corn starch slurry. 8 Add the green part of the spring onion and the cooked onion back in. Toss everything together and serve with rice. #ChickenStirFry #TakeoutStyle #EasyDinner #ChineseCooking #RiceBowl

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Glossy Honey Garlic Chicken A quick and simply delicious meal to make - juicy seared criss crossed chicken breasts lacquered in a glossy honey garlic sauce. Served over creamy buttery mash and a side of crispy lightly seasoned green beans. Enjoy and follow along for more - @marisakapeal 🙏🏼♥️ Chicken (for 2 large breasts sliced in halves) * 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced in halves and criss crossed with a knife) * 1 tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp paprika * 1½ tbsp olive oil * 1 tbsp butter Green beans * 2 cups green beans washed and trimmed * Salt and pepper to taste  * Drizzle of olive oil and splash of water  Honey Garlic Sauce * ½ cup honey * 1½ cups chicken broth * 1 tsp dark soy sauce * 2 tbsps low sodium soy sauce  * 6–8 garlic cloves, finely grated or minced * 1 tbsp rice vinegar or apple cider vinegar * ½ tsp black pepper * Pinch red pepper flakes, optional * 1½ tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp cold water * 2 tbsp cold butter, for finishing Mash: 6-8 yukon gold potatoes peeled and rinsed  1/4-1/2 cups heavy cream room temperature 1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature  Salt and pepper to taste  	1.	Marinate chicken: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally into 4 thinner cutlets. Lightly score in a crisscross pattern, then coat with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika. 	2.	Mashed potatoes: Peel and rinse 6–8 Yukon Gold potatoes. Boil in heavily salted water until fork-tender. Drain and steam-dry for 10 minutes, then mash with ½ cup softened butter, ¼–½ cup heavy cream, and salt and pepper until smooth and creamy. 	3.	Sear chicken: Heat a little olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 1–2 minutes per side until golden, then remove. Chicken will finish cooking in the sauce. 	4.	Honey garlic sauce: In the same skillet, sauté garlic for 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, honey, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, vinegar and red pepper flakes. Simmer briefly, then gradually stir in cornstarch slurry until slightly thickened. 	5.	Finish chicken: Return chicken to the sauce and simmer, spooning sauce over top, until cooked through (165°F). Remove from heat and swirl in 1–2 tbsp cold butter for a rich, glossy finish. 	6.	Green beans: Sauté green beans with a splash of olive oil and water. Season lightly with salt and pepper and cook for a few minutes until tender-crisp. #honeygarlic #kitchen #cooking #explore #recipe

Notice the GarlicDalek T did you? 😏😂 Follow the link in my bio for the link 💪❤️ HIGH PROTEIN HONEY GARLIC BUTTER CHICKEN MAC & CHEESE 9.5/10 — bloody lovely. 😂 Creamy, cheesy mac & cheese with sticky honey garlic chicken. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Lemon Chicken Just Got an Upgrade 🍋🧄 This is one of our favorite dinners to make during the week and it’s going to be yours too. Lemon Garlic Chicken with Cherry Tomatoes has a little bit of everything to please anyone. I think this one really takes lemon chicken to the next level with the chili pepper garlic and tomato for a quick one pan meal that just tastes good every single time. Ingredients: 1 lb Thinly sliced chicken breast filets 1 cup Cherry tomatoes (halved) 3 cloves Garlic (chopped) 1/4 cup White wine Juice of 1 lemon Flour Olive Oil Salt and Pepper Chili pepper Knob of butter Chopped parsley Directions:  1. Thinly slice chicken breast filets and toss in flour. 2. Sear the chicken in olive oil on both sides. 3. Season with salt and pepper. 4. Add in the white wine. 5. Once the alcohol cooks out, add in tomatoes, garlic, chili pepper, and the juice of 1 lemon. 6. Cook until the tomatoes start to wilt. 7. Finish it off with butter and parsley. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

Valentine’s Day Dinner - Ep. 2: Spicy Vodka Chicken Parm Pasta 🔥❤️ recipe ⬇️ 1 large chicken breast, butterflied and pounded thin 2 eggs 2 cups seasoned breadcrumbs or use panko and season with salt, Italian seasoning, garlic & onion powder  1/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Slice chicken breasts in half. Place in a ziplock bag or plastic wrap. Pound with anything heavy until super thin. Dip in egg and then in seasoned breadcrumbs/panko. Press down so the breading sticks. Thoroughly spray with oil and air fry 380F for 10 min. Immediately sprinkle salt over fried chicken. Top with vodka sauce ⬇️ and slices of mozzarella. Air fry again for 1-2 minutes until cheese is melted.  Vodka Sauce 1 tbsp olive oil & butter 1/2 large onion, finely chopped 4-6 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes 1 & 1/2 tbsp tomato paste 1 or 2 shots of vodka, wine or broth 1 cup heavy cream 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 3/4 cup Parmesan 2 tbsp butter 8 oz pasta Melt butter and oil in a large pan. Sauté onion until translucent. Add garlic and red pepper flakes. Once fragrant add tomato paste and cook down for a few minutes. Pour in vodka and once most of it evaporates, incorporate heavy cream. Season with Italian seasoning, paprika and Parmesan cheese. Mix in al dente pasta along with more parm, pasta water and butter.  #pasta #chickenparm #vodkasauce #rigatoni #cheese

High Protein Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice🍗🍘 57g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 6 Total) 562 Calories 56gC | 11gF | 57gP Ingredients: 1.2KG Thinly Sliced Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 2 Tsp Olive Oil 1/2 Diced Brown Onion 500g Diced Capsicum/Bell Peppers 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 960g Cooked White Rice Creamy Cajun Sauce: 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 400ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 150g Light Cream Cheese 1/2 Tsp Chilli Powder 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 30g Grated Parmesan Cheese Steps:  1. Start by seasoning your thinly cut/butterflied chicken breast generously on each side with cajun seasoning, olive oil & mix well until each piece is fully coated. 2. Cook the chicken on medium - high heat for approximately 4 minutes on each side, once cooked set it aside. 3. Leave the chicken juice in the pan & cook diced brown onion, diced capsicum/bell peppers & diced garlic cloves until softened. 4. Add light butter to the middle of the pan with a bit of cajun seasoning & let the seasoning toast for approximately 1 minute, then add cooked white rice & mix well until fully incorporated. 5. To a seperate pan on medium heat add light butter with a bit more cajun seasoning, after about 1 minute add light evaporated milk with a bit more cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, grated parmesan cheese & mix until smooth & creamy. 6. Equally distribute the chicken, rice & sauce into 6 servings, sprinkle with parsley flakes & enjoy.  #chickenrecipes #mealprep #easyrecipe #highprotein #healthyrecipes

one pot creamy garlic chicken pasta  An easy weekday dinner to feed the whole family! You’ll need  500g chicken diced  1 tsp salt  1 tsp paprika  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp parsley  For the sauce  1 heaped tbsp butter  5-6 cloves garlic crushed Salt to taste  1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp chilli flakes  1.5 tsp italian seasoning 200 ml double cream  300g pasta  500ml water  150 g mozzarella cheese grated  Method  Marinate chicken + cook down in olive oil, remove from the pan  In the same pan add butter  Add garlic and fry till fragrant  Add spices, fry for 30 seconds and add some water so it doesnt burn Add double cream and simmer  Add pasta and water and cover with the lid  When pasta is cooked to your liking, add chicken and cheese and stir  Serve hot and enjoy! #onepotmeals #chickenpasta #creamypasta #pastarecipe #easydinner

EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

✨ Want a stunning, weed-free flower bed? Try this easy "pot-in-pot" landscaping hack to keep your borders looking fresh all year long! 📦 First, lay down cardboard along your path and space out heavy-duty black base pots on top. The cardboard acts as an amazing, natural weed barrier. 💧 Next, pour gravel all around the base pots. This hides the cardboard, holds your base pots securely in place, and provides excellent water drainage. 🪴 Now just drop your decorative plants-still in their own nursery pots-directly into the base pots! You can swap them out in seconds when seasons change or easily lift them inside if a freeze hits. 💡 Pro-tips: Mix up your flower colors, put the taller plants in the back, and always match your plants to the amount of sunlight that wall gets.

Creamy Queso Chicken Enchiladas ​While going through my kitchen recipe index on a cozy Friday evening and thinking about my sister Gail, I decided to whip up a comforting pan of cheesy enchiladas inspired by our favorite Mexican restaurant nights, and the rich, savory aroma filling the house brought back the happiest memories. GET YOUR COOK ON with NancyG! ​Featuring tender, seasoned shredded chicken wrapped in soft flour tortillas smothered in a velvety queso blanco sauce and bubbling cheddar cheese, then topped with fresh pico de gallo, this decadent dish delivers a creamy, savory, and mouthwatering flavor experience in every single bite. ​written by NancyG The Recipe Collector ​Recipe Basics ​Yield: 5 to 6 servings ​Measurements: USA standard (rounded up) ​Ingredients & Instructions ​Ingredient List: 5 burrito size flour tortillas 3 cups shredded chicken 1 packet taco seasoning 1 cup sour cream 2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded and divided 2 tablespoons chopped green chilies 10 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained 1 pound queso blanco Velveeta, cubed ​Detailed Instructions: ​Preheat your oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. ​In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, taco seasoning, sour cream, half of the shredded cheddar cheese, chopped green chilies, and undrained diced tomatoes with green chilies, mixing until well combined. ​Spoon an equal portion of the chicken mixture down the center of each burrito size flour tortilla, roll them up snugly, and place them seam-side down in the prepared baking dish. ​In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the cubed queso blanco Velveeta in short increments, stirring until smooth and creamy. ​Pour the warm melted queso blanco evenly over the rolled enchiladas in the baking dish, ensuring they are thoroughly coated. ​Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese over the top of the queso sauce. ​Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes until the cheese is completely melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. ​Garnish with fresh pico de gallo and chopped cilantro if desired, then let cool for 5 minutes before serving warm. ​Chef’s Notes & Nutrition ​Chef's notes by NancyG For an extra kick of heat, you can mix a handful of sliced jalapeños into the chicken filling or top the baked enchiladas with fresh diced hot peppers. You can easily substitute Monterey Jack cheese for the cheddar if you prefer an extra-melty, mild finish. ​Nutritional Facts (Per Serving): ​Calories: 610 ​Fat: 34 g ​Protein: 44 g ​Carbs: 34 g ​#TheRecipeCollector #NancyGCookOn! #fyp #Enchiladas #MexicanFood

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

videos.caption: Five plants that separate a designed garden from a planted one. Rosemary — most people treat it as a herb. Designers use it as a structural evergreen with silver foliage, late winter bloom, and serious drought tolerance once established. Echinops — steel-blue globe thistle that holds its form into winter. Pollinators love it, it seeds around just enough, and nothing else gives you that texture. White Cloud Nepeta — all the soft billowing habit of catmint, none of the blue. Cleaner in a white or silver palette. Underused because most people don’t know it exists. Mountain Hydrangea (Hydrangea serrata) — more refined than arborescens, lacecap form, better fall color, and it actually performs in part shade without flopping. Blue Mist Fothergilla (Fothergilla gardenii ‘Blue Mist’) — blue-green foliage all season, then flame in fall. Native, compact, and genuinely beautiful. The plant that makes clients ask “what is that?” #gardendesign #landscapedesign

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking
